scripts.lint: wp-scripts lint-js client tests/js tests/e2e scripts --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern && wp-scripts lint-style 'client/**/*.scss'
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && wp-env start && wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/masthead vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.integration.xml.dist
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build && wp-env start && wp-scripts test-playwright --config tests/e2e/playwright.config.mjs tests/e2e/smoke
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp masthead seed --fixture=wp-content/masthead-fixtures/queue-2026-11-09.json --now="2026-11-09 14:00:00" --reset && wp-scripts test-playwright --config tests/e2e/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && wp-env start && MASTHEAD_SCREENSHOTS=1 wp-scripts test-playwright --config tests/e2e/playwright.config.mjs tests/e2e/screenshots --project=desktop
